attack: A one-shot stop-loss fires on a position worth more than max_order_value (auto and human regimes)
evidence: auto: stop-loss fired -> rejected ('order value 14000 exceeds max_order_value 5000'), rule now triggered, receipt: '[Paper] [AllPath] AAPL: order not submitted' (does not say it was the stop); human: stop-loss queued, the operator's approval was rejected too ('order value 14000 exceeds max_order_value 5000'), rule now triggered
notes: Found while re-running S11 after F1 (not a blind prediction). RiskGate applies max_order_value (and max_daily_trades) to sells, so a one-shot 'sell all' stop on a position worth more than the cap is rejected on every path and its rule is spent: the exit never happens and the stop must be re-armed by hand. The sentinel's own precheck comment already exempts sells for this reason; Executor.execute does not. Exposure depends on the configured cap versus position sizes.
